grabber.description: Core sensor driver. Provides software access to all physical sensors on the Sensing Robot: GiGE Camera, ATI F/T Sensor, Teensy Accelerometer, Camera Light Controller, buttons, and ToF range finders.

impacts.what_changes: The Grabber must execute multi-threaded peripheral management to handle parallel sensor data streams from multiple robot arms simultaneously. The existing threading architecture must be extended to support concurrent operations for each arm.

impacts.characteristic: Usage of a different GiGE camera
impacts.what_changes: Camera selected. ARAVIS SDK is compatible with all GigE Vision cameras so no software change is required for standard GiGE swaps. For non-standard types (thermal, hyperspectral) additional investigation may be needed outside this characteristic.

impacts.characteristic: Addition of an extra sensor modality
impacts.what_changes: Grabber processing architecture must be extended for: Tactile/Force sensing. Either route new sensor data through existing microcontrollers (Arduino_Thread / Teensy_Thread) or add a new driver thread. Tactile_Features_Calculator may also need updating.

flags.message: Changes span 5 module(s). Phased integration and cross-module testing is strongly recommended.

orienteering_solver.description: Generates optimal schedules for cleaning robots to address defects. Determines the sequence of defects to visit and service time to spend on each. Problem variants: OP (default), TSP, TOP (multi-arm), OPTW (time windows), OPVP (variable profit).

impacts.what_changes: Scheduling problem changes from Orienteering Problem (OP) to Team Orienteering Problem (TOP). Multiple agents must cooperatively share and schedule defect remediation tasks. Algorithm and Hyperparameters processes must be reconfigured for multi-agent scheduling.
Material(s): metal. Profit model and service time lookup must be calibrated for these materials. Partners must supply material-specific profit and service time specifications.

Defect types: Dents/Deformations, Surface damage. Profit function and service time model must be calibrated per defect type. Partners must supply defect-type-specific economic and operational parameters.

impacts.characteristic: Addition of defects have to happen in a certain timeframe
impacts.what_changes: Tight time budget (5.0 minutes). Problem changes from OP to Orienteering Problem with Time Windows (OPTW). Time windows must be encoded in Problem_description. Algorithm and max_compute_time must be updated for a solver that handles time window constraints.

flags.message: Team Orienteering Problem formulation and arm synchronisation must be reviewed by a robotics engineer.
Changes span 5 module(s). Phased integration and cross-module testing is strongly recommended.

localiser.description: Provides localization of entities relative to the robot in the ROS2 TF2 framework. Foundational for motion planning. Supports model-free (approach 1) and model-based localization (approaches 2 & 3, require a 3D mesh).

impacts.what_changes: Localization approach must be selected based on material: metal. Approach 1 (model-free, no mesh), Approach 2 or 3 (model-based, requires mesh). Selection depends on mesh availability (Q7).
Mesh in preparation (). Configuration is provisional — use model-free Approach 1 as placeholder. Revisit and switch to model-based approach once mesh is finalized.

flags.message: Localisation module configuration is provisional until the mesh is available. Revisit this assessment when the mesh is ready.
Changes span 5 module(s). Phased integration and cross-module testing is strongly recommended.

tactile_sensor.description: Detects and classifies surface defects using tactile probe data (force, acceleration). CNN-LSTM / LSTM-CNN ensemble model. Must be retrained whenever materials, object sizes, or defect types change.

impacts.characteristic: Different materials, object sizes, dirt/dent types, and time constraints
impacts.what_changes: Tactile Classifier ML model must be retrained on labeled data for: metal. Retraining pipeline: Pre_calculations → Neural_network (CNN-LSTM) → Ensemble. Collect new material-specific tactile data before retraining.

impacts.characteristic: Different materials, object sizes, dirt/dent types, and time constraints
impacts.what_changes: Object size: variable sizes. Size affects how training data is collected and how the tactile model is trained. Data collection protocols must reflect the contact dynamics appropriate for this size.

impacts.characteristic: Different materials, object sizes, dirt/dent types, and time constraints
impacts.what_changes: Tactile Classifier must have training data for defect types: Dents/Deformations, Surface damage. Classes in the CNN-LSTM output layer must match the selected types. Re-label and retrain if any type is new.

flags.message: New material selected — vision and tactile classifiers must be retrained on data covering this material.
Dents and surface damage require 3D or depth-aware data. Verify labelled examples exist before training.
Changes span 5 module(s). Phased integration and cross-module testing is strongly recommended.

vision_classifier.description: Visual defect detection and classification using camera images. Implicitly affected when new materials are introduced — model must be retrained and the Vision Model Name parameter in the Configuration Module must be updated.

impacts.characteristic: (implicit) Retrain vision model on new material data
impacts.what_changes: Vision Classifier model must be retrained on images of: metal. Update Vision Model Name parameter in the Configuration Module after retraining.
impacts.reason: Q5: New material(s) selected — vision retraining required

flags.message: New material selected — vision classifier must be retrained on data covering this material.
Changes span 5 module(s). Phased integration and cross-module testing is strongly recommended.
